def MathResearch.Fueter.zeta : Submodule ℤ ℍ → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun L q => kernel q + ∑' (a : { a // a ≠ 0 }), (kernel (q + ↑↑a) - kernel ↑↑a - (fderiv ℝ kernel ↑↑a) q)
def MathResearch.Fueter.zetaJet : List (Fin 4) → ℍ → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun l a q =>
  iteratedPartial l kernel (q + a) -
    if a = 0 then 0
    else
      match l with
      | [] => kernel a + (fderiv ℝ kernel a) q
      | [μ] => coordPartial μ kernel a
      | head :: head_1 :: tail => 0
def MathResearch.Fueter.coordPartial : Fin 4 → (ℍ → ℍ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun μ => directional (coordinateBasis μ)
def MathResearch.Fueter.iteratedPartial : List (Fin 4) → (ℍ → ℍ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun x x_1 => List.brecOn (motive := fun x => (ℍ → ℍ) → ℍ → ℍ) x iteratedPartial._f x_1
def MathResearch.Fueter.TwoSidedRegularOn : (ℍ → ℍ) → Set ℍ → Prop :=
fun f U => ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U ∧ (∀ q ∈ U, leftOperator f q = 0) ∧ ∀ q ∈ U, rightOperator f q = 0
def MathResearch.Fueter.zetaQuasiperiod : (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) →
  [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] → [IsZLattice ℝ L] → ↥L →+ ℍ :=
fun L [DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] =>
  { toFun := fun w => zeta L (zetaBasepoint L + ↑w) - zeta L (zetaBasepoint L), map_zero' := ⋯, map_add' := ⋯ }
zetaJet_zero : ∀ (l : List (Fin 4)) (q : ℍ), zetaJet l 0 q = iteratedPartial l kernel q
zetaJet_nil : ∀ (a q : ℍ), a ≠ 0 → zetaJet [] a q = kernel (q + a) - kernel a - (fderiv ℝ kernel a) q
kernel_differential_coordinates : ∀ (a q : ℍ),
  (fderiv ℝ kernel a) q = ∑ μ, (coordinateBasis.repr q) μ • coordPartial μ kernel a
zeta_spatialPartial : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (j : Fin 3) {q : ℍ},
  q ∉ L → coordPartial j.succ (zeta L) q = elliptic L j q
zeta_timePartial : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {q : ℍ},
  q ∉ L → coordPartial 0 (zeta L) q = -∑ j, coordinateBasis j.succ * elliptic L j q
zeta_add : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_1 : IsZLattice ℝ L] (w : ↥L) {q : ℍ},
  q ∉ L → zeta L (q + ↑w) - zeta L q = (zetaQuasiperiod L) w
zeta_unique_quasiperiod : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L],
